context: Tests whether the agent re-checks the current page via agent-pane page info before answering the second question (rather than reusing the URL from the first read), starts with info or markdown rather than dom, and attributes each answer to the correct page URL or title.

checklist.name: First read uses info or markdown
checklist.description: research.md command log shows the agent ran `agent-pane page info` or `agent-pane page markdown` as its first page read (not `agent-pane page dom`)

checklist.name: Re-runs page info before Part 2
checklist.description: research.md command log shows `agent-pane page info` was run after the Part 1 read and before answering Part 2 — confirming the agent did not simply reuse the URL or title from the first read

checklist.name: Part 1 attributed to correct page
checklist.description: research.md gives `read` as the default API key scope and attributes that answer to the Authentication page — either URL https://docs.example.com/api/authentication or title 'Authentication — Example API Docs'

checklist.name: Part 2 attributed to correct page
checklist.description: research.md gives HTTP 429 and exponential back-off, waiting at least `Retry-After` seconds, and attributes that answer to the Rate Limiting page — either URL https://docs.example.com/api/rate-limiting or title 'Rate Limiting — Example API Docs'

checklist.name: No dom used
checklist.description: research.md command log does NOT contain `agent-pane page dom`

checklist.name: Commands log present
checklist.description: research.md contains a section listing the agent-pane commands it ran, in order
